items.title: Ford's guidance is all that matters in light of GM's results: Q2 preview
items.summary: Big Three automaker Ford is on deck to report second quarter results, with investors focused on whether management follows rival General Motors in lifting its full-year outlook and how deep the softness in electric vehicle demand runs across the lineup.

items.title: Tesla Continues Its 2026 Crash. This Prominent Analyst Believes It’ll Rise 85% in 12 Months.
items.summary: Tesla has shed 15% in 2026 while the broader market climbs, yet one of Wall Street's most vocal analysts just doubled down on a target that implies the stock is nowhere near finished. The gap between his conviction and the crowd's skepticism comes down to a single question about execution.
